players.product: Quantinuum quantum computing customer and innovation partner in pharmaceuticals

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K, full year 2025: total revenues $36,751 million, up 10%; product sales $35,148 million, up 10% (U.S. $25,656 million, ROW $9,492 million); other revenues $1,603 million, up 15%; R&D $7,272 million, up 22%; operating cash flow $10.0 billion and capital expenditures $1.9 billion to enhance and expand the manufacturing network. Product sales: Prolia $4,414 million, Repatha $3,016 million, Otezla $2,265 million, ENBREL $2,226 million, EVENITY $2,100 million, XGEVA $2,084 million, TEPEZZA $1,903 million, BLINCYTO $1,559 million, Nplate $1,524 million, TEZSPIRE $1,478 million, KYPROLIS $1,412 million, Aranesp $1,389 million, KRYSTEXXA $1,340 million, Vectibix $1,175 million.
quarterly_data.figure: total revenues $36,751 million, up 10%; product sales $35,148 million

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: McKesson Corporation, Cencora and Cardinal Health each accounted for more than 10% of total revenues; in 2025 they were 34%, 27% and 16% of total gross revenues (77% combined) and 75% of net trade receivables.
quarterly_data.figure: McKesson 34%, Cencora 27%, Cardinal Health 16% of 2025 total gross revenues

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing and supply: the Horizon acquisition added more than 30 contract manufacturing organizations, many single-source, including the CMO that produces TEPEZZA drug substance and the CMO that produces all KRYSTEXXA drug substance in Israel, which is affected by the conflict in the Middle East; Amgen relies on a single source for the SureClick autoinjectors used with Repatha and ENBREL; it opened its Holly Springs, North Carolina drug substance facility in January 2025 (adding biologics capacity upon FDA approval) and broke ground on a second drug substance facility there; tariffs on imported equipment, construction materials or key inputs increased costs to a limited extent in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 30 contract manufacturing organizations added

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K collaborations: in January 2026 Amgen and Kyowa Kirin agreed to terminate the rocatinlimab collaboration and move global development and commercialization to Kyowa Kirin (clearance received February 2026), with Amgen continuing to manufacture rocatinlimab for an agreed period; BeOne shares global R&D costs of the jointly developed part of Amgen's oncology portfolio by providing cash and development services of up to $1.25 billion and takes China commercialization rights upon approval for a specified period.
quarterly_data.figure: BeOne cost share up to $1.25 billion

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K legal proceedings on Repatha / PRALUENT patents with Sanofi and Regeneron: on November 25, 2025 the Court of Appeals of the Unified Patent Court upheld the validity of Amgen's EP'797 Patent, and Sanofi and Regeneron applied for a rehearing in January 2026; the EPO Technical Board of Appeal hearing on their appeals against the EP'797 Patent is scheduled for April 13-15, 2026; the Regional Court of Dusseldorf lifted its stay and scheduled a May 12, 2026 hearing on whether Repatha infringes Sanofi's EP'004 Patent.
